title: A New Approach to the Word and Conjugacy Problems in the Braid Groups
note: Adv. Math. 139(2) (1998), 322-353; arXiv:math/9712211v2. Verified via Crossref REST API (DOI 10.1006/aima.1998.1761) and arXiv e-print source (2026-11-28). Introduces the dual (band-generator) Garside monoid on B_n with fundamental cycle delta = a_{n,n-1}...a_{2,1} of word length n-1, left-canonical normal form (Theorem 3.4), and O(|W|^2 n) stepping algorithm (Theorem 3.8).
